mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish. Expect overcast skies over Badger Ridge Middle School with a temperature of 39 degrees, feeling like 29. A full moon is visible tonight, and while the International Space Station passes overhead, cloudy skies will block the view.

Candidate information packets for the 2027 Spring Election are now available at the City Clerk's Office for aldermanic district candidates, with nomination signatures beginning December 1st. Additionally, local property tax bills will be mailed by December 15th, with the first installment due by January 31st.

Local activities happening today include live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, and Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory. Looking ahead to tomorrow, ART House 360 hosts Thursday Night events, and Hop Haus Brewing Co. offers trivia night.

In the weekly police recap, on Wednesday, November 4th, officers responded to a two-vehicle crash in a parking lot on East Verona Avenue, resulting in a driver being arrested for O W I while carrying a child under 16 years old.
Culver's is open today until 10:00 PM, featuring Dark Chocolate Decadence as the flavor of the day. Stop by before closing to enjoy a sweet treat.
